title: 6 Minutes to Broadway | Hottub | 2 Decks + Parking
description:
3 miles from broadway. Affordable luxury. Brand new hot tub. 2023 custom-built home within an easy 6 minute drive to downtown Nashville! 2300 sq. feet to spread out and cozy outdoor spaces. 

Nissan stadium, broadway, Nashville convention center are just minutes away by car. Scooter-friendly area—easy rides to Broadway. Fireplace, double decks, fenced in yard, luxury custom finishes, huge bathrooms, beautiful sunrise, sunset views and much more to enjoy. I’ve added a TV to every room.

The space
🔥 Luxury Nashville Stay | Hot Tub, Rooftop Views + 6 Min to Broadway

Welcome to your upscale Nashville getaway—perfect for groups, celebrations, and unforgettable weekends just minutes from Broadway.

This 2023 custom-built home offers over 2,300 sq ft of beautifully designed space, complete with a private hot tub, double decks, and stunning sunrise and sunset views.

✨ Why guests love this home:
	•	Private hot tub for relaxing nights
	•	Sleeps large groups comfortably
	•	6-minute drive to Broadway & downtown
	•	Double decks + cozy outdoor spaces
	•	Fenced-in yard (great for groups & pets if allowed)
	•	TV in every room
	•	Free parking + easy access

🛋 The space:
	•	Open-concept layout perfect for gathering
	•	Designer finishes throughout
	•	Large bedrooms + oversized bathrooms
	•	Fully equipped kitchen for group meals
	•	Fireplace for cozy nights in

🌇 Outdoor experience:
Enjoy morning coffee at sunrise and unwind in the hot tub as the sun sets over Nashville—your own private retreat just minutes from the action.

📍 Location:
	•	3 miles to Broadway
	•	Minutes to Nissan Stadium & Convention Center
	•	Quick Uber or scooter ride to everything

Whether you’re here for a birthday, girls trip, or weekend getaway, this home delivers the perfect mix of luxury, space, and location.
